uncertainty: Six verified Java YAML paths: SnakeYAML 2.7 (YAML 1.1 SafeConstructor), SnakeYAML Engine 3.2 (YAML 1.2, CoreSchema configured), circe-yaml 0.16.1 (Scala 2.13 wrapper over SnakeYAML 2.2), zio-json-yaml 1.1.2 (Scala 2.13 wrapper over SnakeYAML 2.7), kjson-yaml 3.15 (own Kotlin parser) and SnakeYAML Engine KMP 5.0.0 (Kotlin port of Engine). circe-yaml and zio-json-yaml are clearly labelled wrappers in the SnakeYAML family from separate projects: their own lines (72 and 38) are identical on both controls, and the control differentials (113 and 120 lines) are in the SnakeYAML scanner, parser and reader they call; their Json numbers carry no int/float tag, so the harness types an exact-Long number as int (the controls hold no integral-valued floats). kjson-yaml is an independent Kotlin parser (derived from the same author's yaml-simple); SnakeYAML Engine KMP is a Kotlin translation of SnakeYAML Engine (same family, separate code) whose default LoadSettings use CoreSchema. The cell has six of ten paths because no other positive-metric lead qualifies; every recorded lead is decided (none unresolved). Not run separately or failing above the sixth path (63): jackson-dataformat-yaml 2.x (32,860) and Jackson 3 (5,346) return aliases as anchor names, and the Jackson-based http4k-format-jackson-yaml (804), no.nav.common:yaml (275), networknt yaml-rule (78) and yaml-path are mapping or query layers over that parse step; commons-configuration2 (3,072), vertx-config-yaml (480), night-config yaml, boosted-yaml (4) and bspfsystems yamlconfiguration (13) reject a sequence root; kaml (480) forbids aliases by default and keeps no scalar type; yamlbeans (134) and hoplite-yaml (97) return untyped strings; manifold-yaml (123) reads ~ as a string; eo-yaml, yamlkt, JYaml, yaml-simple and scala-yaml fail parsing, aliases or escapes; configurate-yaml drops nulls. Excluded above it: spring-beans YamlProcessor (59,801) and hutool-setting (871) are optional-dependency SnakeYAML delegations in non-YAML modules, camel-snakeyaml (426) a one-call SnakeYAML data format, camel-yaml-io a writer, solon-config-yaml (1,582), helidon-config-yaml (910), smallrye-config-source-yaml (249) and ktor-server-config-yaml (72) configuration loaders that flatten or stringify scalars, solon.config.yaml (1,549) an empty compatibility jar, citrus-yaml (171) a test DSL, and the circe-yaml Scala 2.12/3 cross-builds the selected source. Below it, maryk-yaml-jvm (45, own Kotlin reader) rejects the '...' end marker after a sequence root, konf-yaml (18) types nulls as "null", moultingyaml_2.12 (12), pureconfig-yaml (10) and autermann yaml (2) lose key order, and circe-yaml-v12 0.16.1 (6) reads ~ as a string under SnakeYAML Engine's default JSON schema (its converter is a 70% line-shared port of circe-yaml's); polyglot-yaml and zio-config-yaml are mapping or configuration layers, the remaining positive hits are cross-builds, KMP root modules, predecessor coordinates, an eo-yaml GWT fork (94.7% shared), empty jars, node classes, CLI or configuration tools. The bounded Maven Central search (query yaml, first 100 of 855 hits) and the named leads are recorded; targeted leads outside the first 100 hits and the zero-metric hits are listed in the snapshot (round_2_targeted_leads, round_3_targeted_leads); deps.dev summed directDependentCount counts package adoption, not YAML-specific use (spring-beans and commons-configuration2 counts are whole-library), and Scala cross-builds are counted per artifact. The two controls cover a schema-neutral YAML 1.2 subset only, not tags, merge keys, multi-document streams, complex keys or YAML 1.1-only scalars. Coverage and AFL++ feedback are parser source lines under JaCoCo. Discovery routes beyond the registry window (checked 2026-11-18; registry-snapshot.json round_4_targeted_leads): the yaml-runtimes list and YAML test-suite matrix (Java: SnakeYAML and SnakeYAML Engine only), deps.dev reverse-dependency samples of SnakeYAML, SnakeYAML Engine and jackson-dataformat-yaml, GitHub 'yaml parser' searches for Java, Kotlin, Scala, Clojure and Groovy, and awesome-lists. None of the 16 positive-metric leads from these routes qualifies: groovy-yaml (4,090; Jackson-based YamlSlurper returns aliases as anchor names), rewrite-yaml (2,501; untyped lossless source tree), jvyamlb (11) and jvyaml (6; JvYAML, hash-ordered maps and wrong \u escapes), yaml4s-snake_2.13 (9; ~ as a string, hash order), yecht (4; Syck keeps \u00e9 literally) and dxyaml (1; hash order) fail the controls; avaje-config (75), the Jenkins snakeyaml-api plugin (74), http4k-format-moshi-yaml (66), yamllint (17), embulk-util-snakeyaml (2) and dahgan-core (1; tokenizer, its loader has 0 dependents) are configuration loaders, repackagings, mapping layers, linters or token streams, and the groovy-yaml Groovy 3 coordinate and yaml4s cross-builds follow their sources. Further Maven Central searches for 'yaml parser', 'yaml-parser', 'yml', 'snakeyaml', 'a:yaml', 'yaml kotlin' and 'yaml scala' (first 100 hits each) and lookups of named JVM leads (Kotlin Multiplatform, Clojure, RAML, YAMLScript), checked 2026-11-18 (registry-snapshot.json round_6_targeted_leads, round6-lead-probes.json), add 15 positive-metric leads, none promoted: korio-jvm (212) and korge's korlibs-serialization-yaml (2) share a 363-line korlibs Yaml reader that returns only the last nested mapping of catalog.yaml and the string '...' for order.yaml; org.raml:yagi (32) passes both controls through SnakeYAML 1.23 but is raml-java-parser's internal grammar framework with no documented input API (one-sentence README, no Javadoc), so it stays an excluded lead unless an undocumented internal API is accepted; the NetBeans SnakeYAML Engine module (64) is a repackaging, Step's plan reader (61) and the SSLR YAML toolkits (3, 1) parse through Jackson YAML, the JBoss Forge YAML addon (45) is a resource layer, the ktx, blahblah and DataForge modules (11, 2, 1) sit on yamlkt, YAMLScript (11) is a JNA binding to a native library, pl.droidsonroids snakeyaml (3) a SnakeYAML fork and com.soywiz:korlibs-serialization-yaml (7) has only pre-releases. tethys-yaml, yamlstar and clj-yaml have no deps.dev package.
